All installation steps place files in appropriate system directories: the binary in `/usr/bin`, configuration in `/etc/goatcounter`, systemd service in `/usr/lib/systemd/system`, and the license in `/usr/share/licenses`. No extraneous or potentially dangerous operations (such as `curl|bash`, `eval`, or data exfiltration) are present. The package provides proper metadata and conflicts with the non-git version of the package, following AUR conventions.
</details>
